script.spoken: Air Florida 90 failed because engine anti-ice left off. Cars on the bridge were crushed, and most people aboard were killed. The crew thought they had full take-off power. They didn't. Engine anti-ice was off, and ice had blocked the pressure probes. The gauges read high while the engines made less thrust. With snow on the wings too, the jet couldn't climb. Winter de-icing and take-off procedures were overhauled.
